Title: The floor
Text: Win battles in a row to fill the streak counter. A full streak opens the portal up; one loss sets the streak back to zero.
Note: B9 info button (ruling 9.12): the floor screen. Never the same sentence as an unlocks.csv / opening.csv Line - tools/probe_b9_info.py checks it

Title: The fight
Text: Each round, every fighter on your side picks one move; then the round plays out. Faster creatures act first, and a move's type against the target's type changes how hard it hits.
Note: The fight screen (PvE). Speed order and type matchups are the two rules the screen does not show on its own

Title: Floor map
Text: Every floor of the tower, ten per zone. Travel to any floor you have reached; the squares on a row are the creatures that live on that floor.

Title: Inventory
Text: Your gear. Click a piece to see its stats, wear it or break it down. When the bag is full, new drops cannot come in, so dismantle what you will not use.

Title: Soul bag
Text: Every creature and egg you own lives here. Click a creature to open its sheet; click an egg to hatch it. The egg's grade tilts the odds of the hatchling's grade, it does not fix it.

Title: Equipment
Text: Your team is your character and two creatures, and this window is the only place you set it. Change gear any time: a fight already running keeps the gear it started with.
Note: The EQUIPMENT window; gear lock from system-equipment.html

Title: Classes
Text: Your character's class sets its stats and its ultimate. Each class grows through three stages as it levels, and the ultimate is learned partway up.
Note: The CLASSES window (opened from the equipment window)

Title: Breeding
Text: Put two creatures in a pen and it keeps working on its own, spending Ichor over time. Each time the bar fills an egg drops into your bag, and the pen starts again.
Note: The BREEDING window; Ichor is the breeding currency

Title: Codex
Text: Every creature in the tower, in order. A ???? card is a creature you have not found yet. The top row lists what the next boss can drop.

Title: PvP arena
Text: Auto PvP attacks a saved copy of another player's team, so they do not need to be online; your own team defends the same way. Competitive PvP is live, against a player who is there.
Note: The PVP ARENA window; competitive rules on system-pvp.html

Title: Rankings
Text: The boards for Auto PvP and Competitive PvP, side by side. Pick PVP or PVE at the top to switch boards.

Title: Settings
Text: Every choice here is saved with your account and follows you to any device you play on.

Title: Premium shop
Text: Spend Wraithgold on boosts. A boost with a duration counts down from the moment you buy it, and its card shows whether it is running.
Note: The PREMIUM SHOP screen; prices and durations live in premium_shop.csv

Title: Creature sheet
Text: One creature's stats, moves and how it grows. The aptitude shape shows which stats it is best at.
Note: The creature sheet (a bag creature or a party member)

Title: Character power
Text: Every hero with a saved team is listed by its character power. The server counts it from your saved build once a day, so a change shows after the next daily update.
Note: Empty state of the CHARACTER POWER board (screen review #11). Server: the daily sweep computes power from the stored save (src/power.js) and writes it when above 0

Title: Highest climb
Text: Clear floor 1 to be listed. The board ranks the highest floor you have reached and updates once a day.
Note: Empty state of the HIGHEST CLIMB board (screen review #11). Server: the daily sweep writes the climb board once the highest floor reached is above 1

Title: Auto PvP
Text: Every hero with a class soul and a creature in the team is listed at the next daily update - at 1500 until your Auto PvP fights move the rating.
Note: Empty state of the AUTO PVP board (screen review #11). Server: every account with a defense snapshot is folded in daily, at its attacker rating or the 1500 seed

Title: Competitive PvP
Text: Play one Competitive PvP match to get a rating. The board shows it after the next daily update.
Note: Empty state of the COMPETITIVE PVP board (screen review #11). Server: the ladder folds the ratings table daily; a rating row is written at a match's end
